source.check: the sixteen divisions and names read from the Belfast Telegraph's 'Ulster local council nominations' (6 May 1936, p. 3), Castlederg list, which states 'there will be no contests in the Castlederg Rural District'

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors in the Castlederg union. Nominations were received on 5 May 1936 and there was no contest in any division; the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for Wednesday 3 June 1936 (Strabane Chronicle, 21 March 1936, p. 4; Belfast News-Letter, 17 March 1936, p. 12); no poll was needed where all seats were filled at nominations. Filed on 1936-06-03, the Tyrone polling day (previously filed under 1936-05-28, 6 Nov 2026). No nomination was received; Mr. Michael M'Crea, the retiring member, was duly re-elected. Returned unopposed.
